claims.text: Hotel Van Zandt is in the Rainey Street Historic District of Austin.

findings.quote: Hotel Van Zandt, nestled in the lively Rainey Street Historic District, celebrates creativity and individuality, embodying Austin’s vibrant music scene and culture.

claims.text: The Rainey Street District is known for its historic charm, bars, live music venues and nightlife.

findings.quote: Explore the best of Austin at Hotel Van Zandt in the Rainey Street District, renowned for its historic charm, trendy bars, iconic attractions, live music venues, and buzzing nightlife.

claims.text: The hotel's accommodations are artistically designed, and the hotel hosts live performances.

findings.quote: Our artistically designed accommodations, live performances, and exceptional Southern hospitality weave the city’s stories into every detail.

claims.text: Pool View King rooms look out over the hotel's rooftop pool.

findings.quote: Our Pool View King rooms greet you with a stunning view of our sparkling rooftop pool

claims.text: The Pool View King High Floor room has a contemporary design infused with local flair.

findings.quote: This room’s chic, contemporary design, infused with local flair, sets the stage for an unforgettable stay

claims.text: Corner King rooms have a spacious layout and a walk-in shower.

findings.quote: Our Corner King rooms offer a spacious layout and a walk-in shower.

claims.text: The Spa Queen/Queen Junior Suite has two queen beds and a seating area.

findings.quote: With two comfy queen-size beds and a plush seating area

claims.text: The Presidential Suite has a living room, a kitchenette and a dining area.

findings.quote: Revel in expansive, stylish spaces with a chic living room, sleek kitchenette, and dining area perfect for legendary nights.

claims.text: An accessible One Bedroom Spa Suite has a separate bedroom and living area, an accessible tub and a roll-in shower.

findings.quote: Enjoy a separate bedroom and living area in our accessible One Bedroom Spa Suite. Featuring an accessible tub, roll-in shower with grab bars, and handheld shower head.

claims.text: Brass Poppy, the lobby cocktail lounge, combines art-nouveau design with modern sophistication.

findings.quote: Located in the vibrant lobby of Hotel Van Zandt in downtown Austin, Brass Poppy is an elevated neighborhood cocktail lounge open daily.
where the timeless allure of art-nouveau design meets modern sophistication

claims.text: Geraldine's serves modern Mexican cuisine with Southern influence alongside live music.

findings.quote: At Geraldine’s, experience a mix of live music and modern Mexican cuisine with southern influence.

claims.text: The hotel's event venues host corporate retreats, intimate celebrations and weddings.

findings.quote: offering the perfect backdrop for corporate retreats, intimate celebrations, and grand weddings.

claims.text: The Presidential Suite has a record player, a vintage upright piano and a poker table.

findings.quote: Enjoy the record player, vintage upright piano, or poker table

claims.text: Geraldine's, on the hotel's fourth floor, hosts intimate performances, jazz brunches and DJ sets.

findings.quote: Located on our 4th floor, enjoy intimate performances, jazz brunches, and DJ sets featuring the best local talent.

claims.text: The rooftop pool has lounge chairs and private cabanas.

findings.quote: Soak up the sun and stretch out on our plush lounge chairs or unwind in one of our premium private cabanas.
Book a cabana at the fourth-floor pool deck

claims.text: The One Bedroom Spa Suite's en-suite bathroom has an oversized soaking tub and a walk-in shower.

findings.quote: In the en-suite bathroom, indulge in a spa-like experience with an oversized soaking tub and a walk-in shower.

claims.text: The hotel provides valet parking; self-parking is not available.

findings.quote: Hotel Van Zandt provides valet parking. Self-parking is **not** available.
